row.body: The checkpoint key is tied to a list that marks the barrier staffed after the relief shift had already signed out.
row.title: Barrier access list

sidecar.gloss: A barrier is recorded as staffed after the relief shift ended.
sidecar.rival_reading: A work site could have used the same barrier and shift list; the timing does not establish who was kept out.

row.body: chalk numbers run across the fire extinguisher and camera. the count skips one place, then resumes in a different hand.
row.title: missing count beside the fire extinguisher

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
